zh: 我得跟我的家庭医生约个时间。
en: I need to make an appointment {with} my GP.

zh: 睡前吃两片。
en: Take two tablets {before} bed.

zh: 我已经咳嗽两个星期了。
en: I've had this cough {for} two weeks.

zh: 我从周一开始就一直觉得很累。
en: I've been feeling tired {since} Monday.

zh: 我儿子对猫过敏。
en: My son is allergic {to} cats.

zh: 我爸爸还在住院。
en: My dad is still {in} hospital.

zh: 医生让我开始吃抗生素。
en: The doctor put me {on} antibiotics.

zh: 他一直受背痛的折磨。
en: He's been suffering {from|with} back pain.

zh: 他今天请病假了，没来上班。
en: He's {off|out} sick today.

zh: 我的腰疼。
en: I have a pain {in} my lower back.

zh: 你应该少吃点糖。
en: You should cut down {on} sugar.

zh: 护士一分钟后就来。
en: The nurse will be with you {in} a minute.

zh: 我在节食，所以不吃蛋糕了。
en: I'm {on} a diet, so no cake for me.

zh: 她工作压力很大。
en: She's {under} a lot of stress at work.

zh: 吸烟对你的健康有害。
en: Smoking is bad {for} your health.

zh: 爬完楼梯我上气不接下气。
en: I was {out of} breath after climbing the stairs.

zh: 医生让我卧床休息几天。
en: The doctor told me to stay {in} bed for a few days.

zh: 他终于在好转了。
en: He's finally {on} the mend.

zh: 药房在诊所的马路对面。
en: The pharmacy is {across|over} the road from the clinic.

zh: 我要去看专科医生，检查一下膝盖的问题。
en: I'm seeing a specialist {about|for} my knee.
